21,500 (UEFA matches){{Cite web |title=2011/12 UEFA Champions League statistics handbook - Clubs |url=https://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/StatDoc/competitions/UCL/01/67/63/78/1676378_DOWNLOAD.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190801101204/https://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/StatDoc/competitions/UCL/01/67/63/78/1676378_DOWNLOAD.pdf |archive-date=1 August 2019 |website=[[UEFA]]}} | clubname = KRC Genk | image = KRC_Genk_logo.svg | image_size = 180px | fullname = {{lang|nl|Koninklijke Racing Club Genk|italic=no}} (''Royal Racing Club Genk'') | founded = {{Start date and age|1988}}, merge of Thor Waterschei with KFC Winterslag | chairman = Peter Croonen | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Jess Thorup]] | league = {{Belgian football updater|KRCGenk}} | season = {{Belgian football updater|KRCGenk2}} | position = {{Belgian football updater|KRCGenk3}} | website = {{URL|https://www.krcgenk.be/|krcgenk.be}} | pattern_la1 = _genk2526h | pattern_b1 = _genk2526h | pattern_ra1 = _genk2526h | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 007aff | body1 = 007aff | rightarm1 = 007aff | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = 0000FF | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _genk2526a | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = 0000FF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = _genk2526t | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = dbaf2d | body3 = dbaf2d | rightarm3 = dbaf2d | shorts3 = 000000 | socks3 = 000000 | current = 2025–26 KRC Genk season }} '''Koninklijke Racing Club Genk''' ({{IPA|nl|ˈkoːnɪŋkləkə ˈreːsɪŋ ˌklʏp ˈxɛŋk}}),{{efn|''Genk'' in isolation: {{IPA|nl|ɣɛŋk|}}.}} commonly known as '''KRC Genk''' or '''Racing Genk''', is a Belgian professional [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Genk]] in [[Limburg (Belgium)|Belgian Limburg]]. Racing Genk plays in the [[Belgian Pro League]] and have won four championship titles; in [[1998–99 Belgian First Division|1998–99]], in [[2001–02 Belgian First Division|2001–02]], in [[2010–11 Belgian First Division|2010–11]] and in [[2018–19 Belgian First Division A|2018–19]]. They have also won five [[Belgian Cup]]s, most recently in [[2020–21 Belgian Cup|2020–21]]. They qualified for the [[UEFA Champions League]] group stage in the [[2002–03 UEFA Champions League|2002–03]], [[2011–12 UEFA Champions League|2011–12]] and [[2019–20 UEFA Champions League|2019–20]]. The club formed in [[1988 in football (soccer)|1988]] by the merger of [[K. Waterschei S.V. Thor Genk|Waterschei Thor]] with '''KFC Winterslag''', from which it took over the [[matricule|matricule number]]. It has been one of the most successful clubs in Belgium since the late 1990s and so they regularly qualify for European competitions. The club has been playing in the first division since the [[1996–97 Belgian First Division|1996–97 season]]. They play their home matches in the [[Cegeka Arena]]. Their main outfit is blue and white."}}
